m: गग्घ् v.l. for √ कख्, to laugh, Dhātup. v, 53.

s: hasane । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvAM paraMakaM-sew .) kaRWyavargatftIyopaDaH । gaga Gati । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: hAse BvA॰ para॰ aka॰ sew । gagGati agagzIt jagagDa ।

m: गगण for गगन, q.v.
गगल n. venom of serpents, Gal.
गगनाधिवासिन् m. = ˚न-ग, VarBṛ. vi, 12, Sch.

s: puM, (gaganarUpADvanA AkASapaTena gacCatIti yadvA gaganADvAnaM vyApya gacCati । anantagaganarUpamadDAnaM vyApya sarvvataH sTita ityeva prakftatAtaparyyArTaH । gama + qaH .) sUryyaH । iti hemacandraH ॥
v: pu॰ gaganADvanA AkASamArgeRa gacCati gama--qa । sUryye hema॰ ।
m: गगनाध्वग m. ‘wandering in the sky’, the sun, L.
a planet, W.
a celestial spirit, W.
गग—˚नाङ्गण n. the celestial vault or sky, Vās.
गगनाङ्गना f. a metre of 4 × 25 syllabic instants.
गगनाग्र n. summit or highest part of heaven, W.

v: na॰ 6 ta॰ । divyodake taqAgAdAvapatite pAtrAdO Dfte meGaniHsftajale । “gaganAmbu tridozaGnaM gfhItaM yat suBAjane । balyaM rasAyanaM meDyaM pAtrApekzi tataHparam rakzoGnaM SItalaM hvAdi jaqadAhavizApaham” suSrutaH ।
m: गगनाम्बु n. rain-water, Suśr. i, 45.
गगनानन्द m. N. of a teacher.
गगनापगा f. = ˚न-सिन्धु, Kād. iii.
गगनारविन्द n. = ˚नकुसुम, Śaṃkar. xxii, 5; Tarkas. 103.
गगनायस् or गगनायस, n. a particular mineral, W.

s: klI, (gaM gAnaM SabdAtmakaM guRaM gacCati yadvA gakAraM BUtezu praTamaBUtatvAt prADAnyaM gacCati । yadvA gacCantyasmin devAdaya iti । “gamergaSca .” uRAM । 2 । 77 । iti yuc gaScAntAdeSaH .) AkASam । ityamaraH । 1 । 2 । 1 ॥ (yaTA meGadUte । 48 । “prekzizyante gaganagatayo nUnamAvarjya dfzwIrekaM muktAguRamiva BuvaH sTUlamaDyendranIlam ॥”) tatparyyAyaH । amaroktaparyyAyAH AkASaSabde drazwavyAH ॥ (teByaH param .) varhiH 19 Danva 20 ApaH 21 pfTivI 22 BUH 23 svayamBUH 24 aDvA 25 sagaraH 26 sasudraH 27 aDvaraH 28 । iti vedaniGaRwO 1 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ “AkASaM praTamaM BUtaM SrotramaDyAtmamucyate । aDiBUtaM taTA Sabdo diSastatrADidEvatam ॥” ityASvameDikaparvva ॥ tasya guRAH । SabdaH 1 vyApfttvam 2 CidratA 3 anASrayam 4 anAlambam 5 ASrayAntaraSUnyam । avyaktam 6 rUpasparSaSUnyattvAt । aDikAritA 7 dravyAntarAnAramBakatvam । apratIGAtitA 8 BUtatvam 9 SrotrendriyopAdAnatvAt । vikftAni 10 dehAntargatacCidrARi । tadyaTA, -- “AkASasya guRaH Sabdo vyApfttvaM Cidrameva ca । anASrayamanAlambamavyaktamavikAritA ॥ apratIGAtitA cEva BUtatvaM vikftAni ca । guRAH paYcASataH proktAH paYcaBUtAtmaBUtatA ॥” paYcAnAM BUtAnAM AtmA prAptiH svakaM svarUpaM tatra lakzitA । iti mokzaDarmmaH ॥ (gaganAt patitAmbuguRaviSezo yaTA, -- “gaganAmbu tridozaGnaM gfhItaM yat suBAjane । balyaM rasAyanaM meDyaM pAtrApekzi tataH param ॥ rakzoGnaM SItalaM hlAdi jvaradAhavizApaham ॥” iti suSrute sUtrasTAne 45 aDyAyaH ॥)
v: na॰ gama--yuc go'ntAdeSaH । RatvaM prAmAdikam “PAlgune gagane Pene RatvamicCanti varvarAH” ityukteH । 1 AkASe 2 SUnyANko । 3 lagnApekzayA daSamarASO tasya uditarASyapekzayA svasvastikasTitatvAt taTAtvaM taTA hi pUrvasyAmeva rASInAmudayena tataH maptamarASyudaye tasya astam daSamarASistu tadA svasvastikasTitaH iti tasya mUrdDasTAkASasTitatvAt taTAtvam । tadguRAdeH AkASaSabde 592 pf॰ vivftiH । suSrute dehasya pAYcaBOtikatvANgIkAreRa “AntarIkzAstu SabdaH SabdendriyaM sarvacCidrasamUho viviktatA ceti” dehasTAkASaDarmmA uktAH “pfTivyaptejo vAyvAkASAnAM samudAyAt dravyABinirvfttiH” ityupakramya dravyagatA gaganajaDarmmAstatroktA yaTA “SlakzRasUkzmamfduvyavAyiviviktamavyaktarasaM SabdabahulamAkASIyam tanmArddavaSOziryyalAGavakaram” । taTAkASaguRaBUmizWaMsaMSamanam” ityupakramya BUtaviSezasAcivyena GAtuviSezasaMSamanakAritvaM tasya darSitaM suSrutena yaTA “Kate jo'nilajEH SmezmA Samameti SarIriRAm । viyatpabanajAtAByAM vfdDimApnoti mArutaH” “tasyAkASaguRaBUyizWaM mfdutvam” iti ca । tasya DarmmaviSezAH BA॰ SA॰ uktA yaTA “AkASasya guRaH SabdovyApitvam Cidrameva ca । anASrayamanAlambamavyaktamavikAritA । apratIGAtitA cEva BUtatvaM vikftAni ca” । “gagabaM gaRADipatimUrttiriti” mAGaH । “avocadenaM gaganaspfSA (svareRa) raGuH । “prekzizyante gaganagatayo nUnamAva rjyadfzwIH” meGa॰ ।
m: गगन n. the atmosphere, sky, firmament, R.; Suśr.; Ragh.; NārUp. &c.
talc, Bhpr.
a: गगनं(णं) — (Some suppose गगण to be an incorrect form, as is observed by a writer: --फाल्गुने गगने फेने णत्वमिच्छंति बर्बराः) 1 The sky, atmosphere; अवोचदेनं गगनस्पृशा रघुः स्वरेण R. 3. 43; गगनमिव नष्टतारं Pt. 5. 6; सोयं चद्रंः पतति गगनात् Ś. 4. v. l.; Śi. 9. 27. --2 (In math.) A cypher. --3 Firmament. --4 Heaven. --Comp. --अग्रं the highest heavens. --अंगना a heavenly nymph, an Apsaras. --अध्वगः {1} the sun. {2} a planet. {3} a celestial being. --अंबु n. rain-water. --उल्मुकः the planet Mars. --कुसुमंपुष्पं ‘sky-flower’; i. e. any unreal thing, an impossibility; see खपुष्प. --गतिः {1} a deity. {2} a celestial being; Me. 46. {3} a planet. --चर (also गगनेचर) a. moving in the air. --(रः) {1} a bird. {2} a planet. {3} a heavenly spirit. {4} a lunar mansion. {5} the zodiac (राशिचक्र). --ध्वजः {1} the sun. {2} a cloud. --विहारिन् a. moving or ranging in the sky; H. 1. 21. (--m.) {1} a luminary. {2} the sun. {3} a celestial being. --सद् a. dwelling in the air. (--m.) a celestial being; Śi. 4. 53. --सिंधुः f. an epithet of the Ganges. --स्थ, --स्थित a. situated in the sky. --स्पर्शनः {1} air, wind. {2} N. of one of the eight Maruts.

k.v: द्योदिवौ द्वे स्त्रियामभ्रं व्योम पुष्करमम्बरम्. नभोऽन्तरिक्षं गगनमनन्तं सुरवर्त्म खम्. वियद्विष्णुपदं वा तु पुंस्याकाशविहायसी। विहायसोऽपि नाकोऽपि द्युरपि स्यात्तदव्ययम्. तारापथोऽन्तरिक्षं च मेघाध्वा च महाबिलम्. विहायाः शकुने पुंसि गगने पुन्नपुंसकम्.।

द्योदिवौ द्वे स्त्रियामभ्रं व्योम पुष्करमम्बरम्. नभोऽन्तरिक्षं गगनमनन्तं सुरवर्त्म खम्. वियद्विष्णुपदं वा तु पुंस्याकाशविहायसी। विहायसोऽपि नाकोऽपि द्युरपि स्यात्तदव्ययम्. तारापथोऽन्तरिक्षं च मेघाध्वा च महाबिलम्. विहायाः शकुने पुंसि गगने पुन्नपुंसकम्.।

m: गगन—भ्रमण m. = -ग, VarBṛ., Sch.

s: puM, (gagane gaganasya vA Dvaja iva .) meGaH । iti hArAvalI ॥ sUryyaH । iti hemacandraH ॥
v: pu॰ gaganasya Dvaja iva । 1 meGe, hArA॰ 2 sUryye hemaca॰
m: गगन—ध्वज m. the sun, L.
a cloud, L.
गगन—चारिन् mfn. coming from the sky (voice), Daś. i, 111.

v: tri॰ gagane carati cara--wac । AkASagAmini devasUryyAdigrahavihagAdO । tatra vihage “nisUdayan bahubiDamatsyajIvino buBukzito gaganacareSvaraH (garuqaH) tadA” BA॰ A॰ 28 a॰ ।
m: गगन—चर m. ‘moving in the air’, a bird, MBh. i, 1339.
गगन—ग m. ‘moving in the sky’, a planet, VarBṛ. ii, 1, Sch.
गगन—गञ्ज m. a kind of Samādhi, Kāraṇḍ. xxiii, 162
N. of a Bodhisattva, xii, xvi; Lalit. xx, 83.

v: pu॰ gagane gatiryasya । 1 deve 2 sUyyAMdigrahe 3 AkASagAmini tri॰ । 7 ta॰ । 4 AkASe gatO strI ।
m: गगन—गति m. ‘moving in the air’, a sky-inhabitant, Megh.
गगन—कुसुम n. ‘flower in the sky’, any unreal or fanciful thing, impossibility.
गगन—लिह् mfn. reaching up to heaven, Śiś. xvii, 39.
गगन—मूर्धन् m. N. of a Dānava, MBh. i; Hariv.

v: pu॰ dAnavaBede । “taTA gaganamUrdDA ca vegavAn ketumAMSca yaH” BA॰ A॰ 65 a॰ । danuvaMSakaTane । “taTA gaganamUrdDA ca kumBanABo mahAsuraH” hari॰ 3 a॰ ।

m: गगन—नगर n. ‘a town in the sky’, Fata Morgana, Siṃhās.
गगन—परिधान mfn. ‘sky-clothed’, stark-naked, BhP.

v: pu॰ dEtTaBede । “prahRAdo'SvaSirAH kumBaH saMhlAdo gaganapriyaH” hari॰ 42 a॰ ।
m: गगन—प्रिय m. ‘fond of the sky’, N. of a Dānava, Hariv.
गगन—पुष्प n. = -कुसुम, W. (cf. ख-प्˚.)
गगन—रोमन्थायित n. ‘something like ruminating on the sky’, absurdity, iv, 48.
गगन—रोमन्थ m. ‘ruminating on the sky’, nonsense, absurdity, Sarvad. xiii.
गगन—स्थ mfn. situated or being in the sky, W.
गगन—स्थित mfn. id., W.

m: गगन—सद् m. an inhabitant of the air, celestial being, Śiś. iv, 53
= -ग, Gol.
गगन—सिंह m. N. of a Kacchapa-ghāta king, Inscr.
गगन—सिन्धु f. the heavenly Gaṅgā, Kād.
गगन—स्पर्शन m. ‘touching the sky’, N. of one of the 8 Maruts, Yājñ. ii, 100 ff., Sch.
air, wind, W.
गगन—स्पृश् mfn. touching i.e. inhabiting the air, Śiś. xiii, 63
= -लिह्, Ragh. iii, 43.
गगन—तल n. the vault of the sky, firmament, VarBṛS.; Kād.
गगन—वल्लभ n. ‘sky-favourite’, N. of a town of the Vidyā-dharas, HPariś. ii, 644.
गगन—विहारिन् mfn. moving or sporting in the sky (the moon), Hit. i, 2, 15, Sch.
गगन—विहारिन् m. a heavenly luminary, W.
the sun, W.
a celestial being or divinity, W.

a planet, Siddhāntaś.
a lunar mansion, ib.
a heavenly spirit, W.
